review.synopsis: Independent checks confirm the frozen contract: all 80 candidate scores, selected model and 24 held-out predictions agree. Accuracy improves from 0.50 to 1.00; 60 >= 24 meets the fixture criterion. Captured deliverables and the disclosed checker correction are verified.

validation.boundary: 128 ordinary tools retained; customer-only tools excluded; Nisa retained

limitations: Browser file chooser was blocked by automation extension file access; uploads were verified using the same application HTTP endpoints and signed object transfers.
Browser download click opened a new tab, but the automation download event timed out; artifact downloads and contents were independently verified over the authenticated HTTP endpoints.
This small test used a CPU sandbox. GPU selection and funding plumbing are implemented; an actual GPU rental was not exercised by this fixture.
Stripe is sandbox only; no live customer charge was tested.
